crop_monitor.enso_note: Strong El Niño conditions are present and strengthening; the event will likely be very strong from September 2026 to January 2027 (>96% chance, October 2026 NOAA ENSO outlook), with El Niño conditions forecast through April 2027 (98% chance). With a positive Indian Ocean Dipole, above-normal October to December rainfall is forecast across much of East Africa, raising the risk of heavy rainfall and flooding, especially in the eastern Horn.
